checkpoints.note: The first attacker-controlled GeneralName inside the SubjectAltName extension is materialized into the head `subject_alt_name` node. That makes `cur->buf.p` non-NULL, which is the state the next loop iteration uses to allocate `subject_alt_name->next` and later store the malformed tail entry.

After the malformed-entry cleanup frees every node reachable from `subject_alt_name->next`, the function returns the fatal SAN-parse error immediately without clearing `subject_alt_name->next`. The head sequence therefore keeps a dangling pointer while the same `ret` drives caller cleanup into `mbedtls_x509_crt_free`. The patch fixes this by inserting `subject_alt_name->next = NULL;` before the return.
